name: hawkbucks-demo-deploy-receipt
comment: DEMO-ONLY build receipt. Pages Direct Upload ignores this file at deploy time: real Demo bindings live on the hawkbucks-demo Pages project (dashboard/API), NOT in any wrangler file. This file exists ONLY so the Nitro cloudflare-pages build merges CURRENT demo references (hawkbucks-web-demo + hawkbucks-demo D1) into dist/_worker.js/wrangler.json for review, without ever touching frontend/wrangler.json (production). NEVER rename to wrangler.json. NEVER point at production resources.
